svg.text: generator → oracle vs observed labels (snapshot) → collators → RQ-VAE / TIGER / HSTU + PLE (unified funnel loss) / ZILN / PRM → calibrators → results tables
Synthetic generator (format v2) — oracle labels + decision delays
financial state correlated with FICO / DTI / income
APPLY_PENDING when ts + delay > snapshot (= 365 d)
Observed labels at the training cut-off T_snap (D1: a labeling concern, not an architectural one)
status = observed_status(y_apply, served_at, delay, T_snap, y_approve)
NOT_APPLIED / APPROVED / DECLINED → approve_observed, y_approve as is
'negative': pending trained as declined (baseline, wrong by construction)
Model training (training/trainers.py; one OptimizerConfig per model, training/config.py)
history term: every slot j+1 predicted from j
target term: c_1 from last token, c_k from c_{k−1}
CE restricted to each level's 32 tokens
AdamW 1e-3, wd 0.01 (no decay on emb / bias / LN),
keep all clicked rows, non-clicked w.p. r = 0.25
HSTU + PLE ranker — Unified Funnel Loss (losses/funnel_loss.py::UnifiedFunnelLoss)
L_apply = mean_{y_click} BCE(z2, y_apply) (clicked rows; ssb_mode 'ips': × 1/clip(p1)) λ_apply = 1
L_approve = mean_{y_apply ∧ approve_observed} w · BCE(z3, y_approve), w = approve_weight λ_approve = 1
w′ = 1 non-applied, w resolved, 0 pending (s_k = logsigmoid(z_k); log1mexp in losses/stable.py)
L_amount = losses/ziln_loss.py::ziln_loss NLL on resolved APPROVED rows only (amounts > 0) λ_amount = 0.1
every masked term ÷ mask sum (not B·K); loss_balancing fixed | running_mean | uncertainty; detach_upstream flag
AdamW 1e-3, wd 0.01, warmup 500 → cosine 10 %, clip 1.0, batch 64 slates × K = 100; early stop: val total (patience 3)
SSB correction = entire-space terms on the SAME towers (no second ESMM network); business objectives never enter
trained ranker → predict(): z1 + log r, z2, z3, amount logits
After model training: calibrators, then PRM (Stage 4 pieces trained on their own data)
data: calibration split (10 % of users); never used for training
p1: all rows; p2: clicked rows; p3: resolved applications × w
'auto' = lower held-out weighted NLL, refit on the full split
never fitted on rows with approve_observed = False
→ CalibratorSet (JSON) used by serving and every results table
examples: train slates → predict → calibrate → value → guardrails → top-10
features [h_cand ‖ p̂ ‖ EV NB U ‖ family ‖ position]; labels = y_click
(ListNet softmax CE + λ · same-family penalty, λ = 0)
q ∝ y_click ('click', default) or softmax(U / 25) ('utility'); ≥ 1 positive
AdamW 5e-4, wd 0.01, warmup 200 → cosine 10 %, clip 1.0, batch 128 slates
early stop: val listwise loss (patience 3); β = 0.5 rerank is inference-only
Evaluation — scripts/evaluate.py emits docs/results/*.md (every number in the write-up comes from here)
AUC, PR-AUC, GAUC, NCE per task + oracle ceiling;
p3 on resolved rows × w (revenue = lower bound)
isotonic vs Platt ECE / MCE / Brier, tower & tier
pending_policy drop / ipw / negative on a
